title: [BUG] have_forced_answer causes max_iter configuration to be invalid.
body:
### Description

The first time the number of iterations reaches the value of max_iter, the loop enters and executes, then modifies self.have_forced_answer = True in the else block. After that, the loop is never entered again.

### Steps to Reproduce

                    if self._should_force_answer():
                        if self.have_forced_answer:
                            return AgentFinish(
                                thought="",
                                output=self._i18n.errors(
                                    "force_final_answer_error"
                                ).format(formatted_answer.text),
                                text=formatted_answer.text,
                            )
                        else:
                            formatted_answer.text += (
                                f'\n{self._i18n.errors("force_final_answer")}'
                            )
                            self.have_forced_answer = True

### Expected behavior

Able to exit the loop based on `max_iter`.
